question: Which event was held at Shri Hari Singh Thapa Sports College in Pithoragarh in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Boxing**__.

• The event held at **Shri Hari Singh Thapa Sports College** in **Pithoragarh** during the **38th National Games** in **2025** is **Boxing**.
 
• **Uttarakhand** is the host state for the **38th National Games**, which are scheduled to take place from **January 28 to February 14, 2025**.
 
• The **Shri Hari Singh Thapa Sports College** was specifically selected as the venue for **Boxing** due to its historical association with the sport and its upgraded infrastructure to meet national standards.
 
• The college is named after the legendary boxer **Hari Singh Thapa**, often referred to as the **"Father of Indian Boxing,"** who hailed from **Uttarakhand** and brought international laurels to the country.
